name: Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
description: Calculates the total revenue generated by each customer across all delivered orders. Use this whenever asked for LTV.
sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) as ltv FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY ltv DESC

name: Product Performance (Total Sales)
description: Calculates the total quantity sold and revenue generated per product. Use this for 'best selling products' or 'product revenue'.
sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_units_sold, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) as total_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'pending' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
